info.name: CityFix API - City Complaint & Service Request Platform
info.description:
REST API for the CityFix platform.

**How to use**
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (live: https://cityfix-b7a6.netlify.app, local: http://localhost:5000).
2. Run the three *Login as ...* requests: tokens are stored automatically.
3. Run *List departments* and *List categories* once: they store the ids used by later requests.

Every response follows `{ success, message, data }` (plus `meta` on paginated lists) or `{ success: false, message, errors }`.

request.description: Public sign-up. Always creates a CITIZEN.
Verifies a Google ID token (GCP OAuth client) and returns API tokens.
Open in a browser: redirects to Google's consent screen, then to /auth/google/callback which returns the tokens.
Rotates the refresh token. Re-using an old one revokes every session.
Current user with department and counters.
Only name / phone / address / avatarUrl are editable.
Blocked with 409 while it owns categories or open complaints.
Routed to the category's department, SLA computed from category + priority.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Huge pothole on Mirpur Road",
  "description": "A deep pothole near the bus stand is causing accidents every day.",
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "address": "Mirpur 10 Circle, Dhaka",
  "ward": "Ward 7",
  "latitude": 23.8069,
  "longitude": 90.3687
}

request.description: Role-scoped: citizens see their own, staff their department, admins everything. Filters: status, priority, type, categoryId, departmentId, assignedToId, ward, assignedToMe, unassigned, overdue, from, to.
Open complaints past their SLA deadline.
Detail with attachments, payments, feedback and SLA status.
Staff must belong to the complaint's department and be under the workload limit. Transactional.
Alternative to admin assignment. Atomic: concurrent claims -> one 200, one 409.
multipart/form-data, field `files` (max 3 per request, 5 MB each, JPEG/PNG/WEBP/PDF). Stored on Cloudinary.
Demonstrates the state machine rejecting a transition.
Within 7 days of resolution. Fresh SLA window.
Citizens: only CANCELLED / REJECTED / CLOSED. Admins: any.
Created as PENDING_PAYMENT with feeStatus UNPAID.

request.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout Session. Open data.checkoutUrl in a browser and pay with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.
Stripe redirects the browser here. The session is re-fetched from Stripe before anything is marked PAID.
Stripe redirects here when the citizen backs out.
Handles checkout.session.completed / expired / async_payment_*. Signature verified against the raw body. Idempotent.
Re-syncs the status from Stripe (covers a missed webhook).
Real Stripe refund. Only for PAID fees of REJECTED / CANCELLED requests.
Audited. Revokes the user's sessions. STAFF requires departmentId.
Counts by status / department, SLA compliance, average resolution time, revenue. Cached for 60s.
Filters: action, entity, entityId, actorId, from, to.
